digest.component_or_area: tests/interfaces conftest fixture setup and rebar_repo template caching
propositions: Fixture setup accounts for 47% of tests/interfaces tier wall-clock due to function-scoped rebar_repo running git init and spawning 58 processes per test across 589 test functions
Session-scoped template built once per xdist worker with per-test copytree reduces 306ms per-test fixture time to 22.3ms by eliminating redundant git init spawns

Copies of the template must have two embedded absolute paths rewritten (.tickets-tracker/.git and gitdir) to avoid writes advancing the template's refs and bare git worktree repair silently corrupts the store
Copies must set REBAR_GATE_TMPDIR per-test to prevent snapshot cache collisions on commit SHA and re-randomize .env-id and .signing-key to enforce environment isolation guarantees

Template fixture must build inside isolated MonkeyPatch.context() with empty XDG_CONFIG_HOME and cleared REBAR_* env vars to prevent first-test autouse environment contaminating template used by all 589 tests
Tier-wide autouse guard asserts all paths in git worktree list --porcelain fall inside REBAR_ROOT to catch half-fixed copies and detect future path-sharing regressions
